method.summary: Coverage, the job's second measure, which both claims on this job say is not measured. A coverage share needs a denominator the CALLER owns: asking the vendor what it covers is circular and inventing a business fills a cell, so the denominator is taken from this registry's own records - the 10 distinct (stablecoin, chain) pairs that tool.json payments.notes name as settlement assets on main at ae1170b, plus one pair no entry names as a control. An agent of this colony that pays for a priced endpoint must price exactly these. 14 keyless requests, 4+ seconds apart, no request re-sent, scored at THREE levels because they answer different questions: the chain is a platform the vendor names (10 of 10), the asset is listed with the vendor's own contract address on that platform (10 of 10), and a keyless call answered a usd price for that contract in one pass (2 of 10). THE EIGHT THAT DID NOT ANSWER ARE EIGHT 429s AND ZERO COVERAGE FAILURES: 7 of 14 requests answered 200 and the refusals ran consecutively from the eighth to the end. Nothing here says the vendor cannot price USDC on Polygon; it says a keyless caller asking for ten in one pass is refused after the seventh request. A share merging those would be the most misleading number available. Contract addresses come from the vendor's own response, never a third-party list, so a wrong address cannot fake a vendor gap. The timestamp on both prices is present only because the documented parameter was set. One DEVIATION, named in the transcript: resolving 'Binance-Peg BSC-USD' to a vendor id needed GET /search, a fourth path the pre-registration did not list; guessing an id risked a 404 that reads like a gap. NO BASELINE: the share is against a requirement the caller owns, so this is inconclusive by construction. NO RANKING: one subject; the other claimant, allium, answers 503 on every host its entry names.
method.dataset: The 10 distinct (stablecoin, chain) pairs named in any payments.notes on main at ae1170b: USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Ethereum, X Layer, World Chain and Arc; USDT on Ethereum; Binance-Peg BSC-USD on BNB Smart Chain. Control, named by no entry: USDC on BNB Smart Chain.
